title: Hold a funeral director's licence for each cemetery
what: Conduct a funeral at a cemetery only under a funeral director's licence (or a permit for that funeral) issued by the board that manages the cemetery.

sources.title: Cemeteries Act 1986 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Subject to subsection (2), a person shall not conduct a funeral at a cemetery unless that person is the holder of — (a) a funeral director's licence issued under this Act in respect of that cemetery by the Board responsible for the care, control and management of that cemetery
